#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

struct Number {
    double z;
    int x;
    int y;
};

struct Name {
    int y;
    double z;
    int x;
};

int main() {
    double h, h2, tel = 0;
    int n;
    Number nn;
    std::vector<Number> v;
    std::vector<Name> w;
    // Read input
    std::cin >> nn.x >> nn.y >> n;
    nn.z = 0;
    double dd = (double)nn.x / nn.y;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        h = std::floor(dd * i);
        h2 = std::abs((h / i) - dd);
        Number t1 = {h, i, h2};
        v.push_back(t1);
        h = std::ceil(dd * i);
        h2 = std::abs((h / i) - dd);
        Number t2 = {h, i, h2};
        v.push_back(t2);
    }
    auto cmp1 = [](const Number& s1, const Number& s2) {
        if (s1.z == s2.z)
            return s1.y < s2.y;
        return s1.z < s2.z;
    };
    std::sort(v.begin(), v.end(), cmp1);
    int hh = 0;
    while (std::abs(tel) < 1e-16 && hh < v.size()) {
        Name sw = {v[hh].x, v[hh].z, v[hh].y};
        w.push_back(sw);
        hh++;
        if (hh < v.size()) {
            tel = v[0].z - v[hh].z;
        }
    }
    auto cmp2 = [](const Name& s1, const Name& s2) {
        if (s1.y == s2.y)
            return s1.x < s2.x;
        return s1.y < s2.y;
    };
    std::sort(w.begin(), w.end(), cmp2);
    std::cout << w[0].x << '/' << w[0].y;
    return 0;
}
